fusions.name: Seed Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a seed that deals 8 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Caged] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Mangrove Grasp
fusions.desc: Roots burst from the bank around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Shallows Bloom
fusions.desc: Raises a reed bank where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 4 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slow Roots
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
